reason: I already paid for an inverter and battery, so I'm not paying again for a second battery inside a washing machine. A normal semi-automatic costs maybe ₹10-12k, and I can run it off my inverter or put the extra money into a bigger battery that runs the fans too.
objection: Why buy a battery that only runs the washer when my inverter already covers the house? And two loads per charge is not much. If that lithium battery dies after the 3-year warranty, I'm stuck with a costly replacement and only the dealer to fix it.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost close to a normal semi-automatic, around ₹14-15k, or if my dealer showed me my inverter really cannot handle a washer motor without tripping
